en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a grand, two‑storey late‑19th‑century building with decorative façades, awnings and large windows, likely a restaurant or café. In front stands a statue or monument on a pedestal with surrounding gas-style street lamps. Several children are visible in the open square in front of the building. Dense trees form a park-like backdrop. The caption at the bottom reads ""Burgerlust" — Nijmegen." and faint lettering on the building suggests the word "RESTAURANT".
